headline: Colombia President Proposes Elimination of Over 100 State Agencies
summary: Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella prepared a public administration overhaul to eliminate, dissolve, or merge 105 of 209 government entities as part of a fiscal adjustment strategy.
why: Sweeping administrative restructurings and bureaucratic reductions aim to curb public expenditure and improve fiscal efficiency.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Structural fiscal reforms impact public expenditure and government operating efficiency.
